added: Bundled Pi Desk documentation navigation, management-command and plugin-development guides, and a runnable local application example.
features: Added persistent, unified desktop download-source settings with official, domestic-mirror and custom npm registry options for environment preparation and managed package downloads.
Added a local npm configuration mode for plugin downloads that preserves registry, scope and authentication settings for installation and preflight checks.
Added the `plugins reload` management command to reload installed plugin code without downloading packages, restarting the host or reloading existing Pi sessions.
changed: Redesigned plugin management with status filters, dedicated detail views, clearer version and update indicators, automatic update checks outside basic mode, and an Update All action.
Plugin batch operations and targeted update checks now process large selections in chunks instead of imposing a 32-plugin selection limit.
Desktop managed-package version checks and installations now retry registry-related failures using the official registry and, when different, the local npm registry.
Pi Desk sessions now receive bundled-documentation guidance through the system prompt instead of the generated Pi Desk skill.
fixed: Fixed mobile Back handling for the terminal, file preview and branch picker, and prevented hidden workbench content from responding while the sidebar is open.
Fixed Escape closing both the image viewer and the dialog underneath it.
Fixed chat scrolling away from the bottom when content rearranges without changing height.
Prevented stale project-model and MCP settings from being edited or saved while switching projects or refreshing configuration; switching MCP scopes now asks before discarding unsaved edits.
Fixed scoped plugin registry overrides affecting unrelated public dependencies, and aligned registry lookups with the npm configuration used for plugin installation.
breaking: Legacy per-service desktop registry settings are no longer read or saved. Configure custom registries in the unified desktop download-source settings instead.
